questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term

8 : 512 :: ? : 1728 :: 18 : 5832
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is,

**Cube of first number = Second number.**

Now, 8 : 512

⇒ (8)³ = 512

and, 18 : 5832

⇒ (18)³ = 5832

Similarly, ? : 1728

⇒ **(12)³** = 1728

So, '12" will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
A # B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the grandmother of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the son of B’.

If E @ F % G # H & I @ J, then how is G related to J if I has only one child?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 &
 @
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Daughter
 Grandmother
 Son
 
 

 

Given : E @ F % G # H & I @ J

It means, E is the grandmother of F, F is the son of G, G is the husband of H,

H is the daughter of I, I is the grandmother of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bce18c69bd530bcc2585cad6e7f497fc634d9d77e4bc92da16b1f6e4a9d80f2.png] 

So, G is the **'Father' **of J.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

**'I' has only one child and it is given that **H is the daughter of I, I is the grandmother of J.

**Thus, H is the only child of 'I'.**

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

41 * 5 * 3 * 10 * 2 = 31
questions.solution:
Given Equation : 41 * 5 * 3 * 10 * 2 = 31

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) + × ÷ -

Given Equation : 41 * 5 * 3 * 10 * 2 = 31

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 41 + 5 × __**3 ÷ 10 **__- 2 = 31

⇒ 41 + __**5 × 0.3**__ - 2 = 31

⇒ __**41 + 1.5**__ - 2 = 31

⇒ __**42.5 - 2**__ = 31

⇒ 40.5 ≠ 31

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 2) **- × + ÷ 

Given Equation : 41 * 5 * 3 * 10 * 2 = 31

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 41 - 5 × 3 + __**10 ÷ 2 **__= 31

⇒ 41 -__** 5 × 3**__ + 5 = 31

⇒ 41 - 15 + 5 = 31

⇒ __**46 - 15**__ = **31**

⇒ 31 = 31 

⇒** LHS = RHS**

Option 3) × - + ÷ 

Given Equation : 41 * 5 * 3 * 10 * 2 = 31

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 41 × 5 - 3 + __**10 ÷ 2 **__= 31

⇒__** 41 × 5**__ - 3 + 5 = 31 

⇒ 205 - 3 + 5 = 31

⇒ 210 - 3 = 31

⇒ 207 ≠ 31

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) ÷ - + ×

Given Equation : 41 * 5 * 3 * 10 * 2 = 31

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**41 ÷ 5**__ - 3 + 10 × 2 = 31

⇒ 8.2 - 3 + __**10 × 2**__ = 31

⇒ 8.2 - 3 + 20 = 31

⇒ 28.2 - 3 = 31 

⇒ 25.2 ≠ 31

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some horses are donkeys.

Some goats are sheep.

All sheep are fishes.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some goats are donkeys.

(II) Some fishes are goats.

(III) Some horses are sheep.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some horses are donkeys.

Some goats are sheep.

All sheep are fishes.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/q80TqsuXTAeeW0au8AW1c63k0gpHVJ2tdD_NjifhZOa6RyhLLLnsXaCg3USOkOeSBiqpbYXM_Y1_X1sSc8YMXDlRoGOvOenfMD_wYUOHR8fJa3v48DNZIrJ-4ArMdB_BMlbY2WQsNuyzRnjDGwHZB98] 

**Conclusion: **

I. Some goats are donkeys - False (Because, No definite relation given between goats and donkeys, so it can be possible only).

II. Some fishes are goats - ** True **(Because, all sheep are fishes, that means, the part of sheep which is goat is also fishes, So, some fishes are goats definitely true).

III. Some horses are sheep - False (Because, No definite relation given between horses and sheep, so it can be possible only).

So, Only conclusion II follows .

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
